note: Data-only trigger-routing fixtures (plugin-wide-6 / batch C4). There is no built-in eval runner; these cases are the fresh-session A/B baseline corpus recorded BEFORE the C1 description POV batch. Post-run user-verification artifact, not a merge gate.

evals.prompt: 我想幫 App 加上離線同步，怎麼設計比較好？
evals.expected_behavior: Plan mode: Stage A alignment questions first, then a five-section approved plan. Never produces code, scaffolding, or pseudo-code.
Evaluation Mode: single-line Kill/Keep/Pivot verdict with rationale. No five-section plan is produced.

evals.prompt: I want to build a rate limiter for our API — which approach should I take?
evals.expected_behavior: Plan mode: approach comparison inside the five-section plan; hands off to implementation or /analyze, writes no code.
Judgment request paired with an existing error/報錯 is debugging — routes to /hunt, not /think Evaluation Mode.

evals.prompt: 幫我分析需求，這個功能橫跨前端、API 和資料庫三層
evals.expected_behavior: Cross-module (≥2 interdependent modules) spec expansion routes to /analyze, not /think.

evals.prompt: 直接幫我把離線同步的 scaffolding 寫出來
evals.expected_behavior: Writing actual code/scaffolding is downstream implementation — /think never does that.
